dslRule:
<!id: add.explicit.compilationUnitContext.cast>
<!description: Add explicit cast to CompilationUnitContext where createContext returns a wider type, following API refactoring.>
<!severity: WARNING>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.template.java.CompilationUnitContext $contextVar = $contextType.createContext($args$); :: instanceof($contextType, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.template.contentassist.CompilationUnitContextType")
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.template.java.CompilationUnitContext $contextVar = (org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.template.java.CompilationUnitContext) $contextType.createContext($args$);
;;
summary: Adds an explicit cast `(CompilationUnitContext)` to the result of `createContext` method calls where the assigned variable is of type `CompilationUnitContext` and the receiver is `CompilationUnitContextType`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
